newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mexico raises July Maya, Isthmus unchanged-traders.
newsitem.headline: Mexico raises July Maya, Isthmus unchanged-traders.

text.p: Mexico has raised the price its contract holders in the Far East will pay for Maya crude loading in July by 15 cents a barrel but has left the price for Isthmus unchanged, Japanese traders said on Monday.
July-lifting Maya was raised by 15 cents from the June price, to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations minus $3.15, traders said.
July-lifting Isthmus was unchanged from the previous month's price of the average of Oman and Dubai quotations plus 40 cents a barrel, they said.
